notes.title: Development has continued - BIG UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello all,

I wanted to give a quick update on the status of Simple Video Recorder.  

Things were put on hold while I worked on another project of mine, https://GamingVPN.com, which has been going quite well.  That project takes an enormous amount of time but I've managed to hire additional staff to help accelerate development on that, freeing up some time to focus back on Simple Video Recorder, something that I personally will be using all the time.

Because of modern advances in Windows 10 and Windows 11, I've decided to completely scrap the back-end of Simple Video Recorder and re-engineering it from the ground-up, taking advantage of more modern ways to record video.  

The end result will still be the same goal:   Simply run the program and click a gigantic red button*, and video gets recorded.  A Simple Video Recorder.

*- Gigantic Red Button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34916760/b25ee7b8cd48fa158b6f24ce5dc6e71b71c48cc0.png[/img]

notes.title: Exciting Project Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

A quick update: This project was delayed due to some personal reasons (newborn baby in the family + covid19 happened) and I'm about to start the project back up again.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34916760/d38af84f774ccf77449351e3c4708fc606da7969.png[/img]

Quick Status:

* Recording video goes great
* Working on streamlining save process
* Adding basic edit features (VERY basic, things like image overlay, text, etc)
* Working on fine tuning audio
* Overall, the project is approx. 85% completed.

I'm in the process of hiring a C++/C# back-up programmer to help assist with the completion of everything and am super excited to move this project forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34916760/47225986bff8e0ec89bc76e322b9fbbdf1c9b36a.png[/img]

Thanks for checking out the app!

~StartupTim
